chunks: As for whatever is in H from Abū al-Ward, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah have mercy on him—from al-Ḥimyarī, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abū al-Ward.

key_terms.أَبِي الْوَرْدِ: Abū al-Ward, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.الْحِمْيَرِيِّ: Al-Ḥimyarī, a transmitter in the sanad/isnad
key_terms.رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ: May Allah have mercy on him; a supplication for the narrator's father
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a transmission formula indicating direct narration by the compiler

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain of Abū al-Ward in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Abū al-Ward in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the line of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for identifying sources and assessing transmission history.
